scoring_justification: Exact work function values depend strongly on DFT code and pseudopotentials; only the relative ordering (NbC work function < Nb work function) is robust and constitutes the paper's claim. A structural check of the ordering, combined with plausible range constraints, is the strongest feasible scoring tier.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper figure 6 and text: work functions of NbC and Nb are 6.3 eV and 7.8 eV respectively, confirming NbC < Nb.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: ordering is the main claim of the computational sub-result; it is the exact structural relation reported and verifiable against the paper's own numbers.

Nb_workfunction_eV.description: Work function of Nb in eV

NbC_workfunction_eV.description: Work function of NbC in eV

outputs.description: The computed work functions of Nb and NbC. The checker verifies that the NbC work function is lower than the Nb work function.

output_contract.notes: The scoring is based on the structural ordering (NbC_workfunction_eV < Nb_workfunction_eV). The exact values are method-dependent and are not targeted; only the relative ordering is scored.

steps.description: Verify that NbC_workfunction_eV < Nb_workfunction_eV and that both values are within plausible range (3.0–10.0 eV).
